jobDescription.name: Responsibilities
jobDescription.value:
• Execute pre-commissioning, cold commissioning and hot commissioning of utility scale BESS projects
  • Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on installed energy storage projects
  • Validate electrical installations, system configuration and performance
  • Troubleshoot faults across DC systems, PCS/Inverters, MV equipment, SCADA and auxiliaries
  • Supervise subcontractors and ensure site works meet safety, quality and project requirements
  • Complete commissioning records, service reports, fault reports and handover documentation
  • Support client training, site handover, warranty investigations and technical reporting
  • Support regional delivery, commissioning and O&M activities, including travel to project sites as required.

jobDescription.name: Requirements
jobDescription.value:
• Electrical, electrotechnical, or equivalent technical qualification, with proven experience in electrical installation, commissioning, maintenance, or fault finding 
  • Proven experience working on utility-scale electrical systems, preferably including BESS, PCS/inverters, DC battery systems, MV/LV switchgear, transformers, SCADA, BMS or EMS systems 
  • PES/PAV and PEI training/qualificationrequired
  • Competence to work under CEI 11-27 / CEI EN 50110 procedures for electrical work, including live LV work, work near live parts and work in the vicinity of HV/MV systems 
  • Practical experience using correctly rated electrical test equipment, diagnostic tools
  • Ability to read and interpret single-line diagrams, electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, interlock logic, commissioning procedures and OEM technical manuals 
  • Experience with installation, commissioning, energisation, maintenance and fault finding across DC systems, PCS/inverters, MV interfaces and SCADA systems 
  • Familiarity with BMS, EMS, SCADA, PLCs, communication networks, HVAC, fire detection/suppression interfaces and auxiliary systems 
  • Ability to work under permit-to-work, lockout/tagout, switching, isolation, RAMS and site safety procedures 
  • Completion of mandatory workplace health and safety training under Italian safety requirements before site deployment 
  • Ability to complete commissioning records, test reports, service reports, fault reports, riskassessmentsand handover documentation accurately 
  • Valid Category B driving licence 
  • Willingness to travel across Italy and internationally as required
  • Location: Italy and/ or Portugal
Preferred / additional 
  • Previousutility-scale BESS installation,commissioningor maintenance experience 
  • Experience with OEM-supplied integrated systems covering DC batteries, PCS, MV equipment and SCADA 
  • Medium-voltage switching experience on 11 kV–33 kV systems 
  • Formal MV switching authorisation under client, DNO/DSOor site rules 
  • Experience on substations, renewable-energy plants, grid-connected storageprojectsor industrial power systems 
  • Knowledge of CEI 0-16 for MV/HV grid-connected plants in Italy 
  • Experience with remote diagnostics, alarm analysis, firmware updates, datalogsand root-cause analysis 
  • Availability for call-out, outage support,overtimeor occasional weekend work
Candidates must hold PES/PAV and PEI training/qualification and must be capable of being formally authorised by the employer to work on or near live/stored-energy electrical systems up to 1,500 VDC and 1,000 VAC in accordance with CEI 11-27 / CEI EN 50110 and Italian safety requirements.

jobDescription.name: Responsibilities
jobDescription.value:
· Partner with regional business teams and regional marketing teams to support business growth through strategic marketing initiatives, customer engagement activities and sales enablement, ensuring alignment between global strategies and regional execution.

· Conduct market research, competitive intelligence and customer insight analysis for the global energy storage industry, providing actionable market intelligence and strategic recommendations to support global marketing planning, go-to-market strategies and business decision-making.

· Monitor global market trends, competitor activities, emerging technologies and customer needs, and prepare regular market intelligence reports, industry updates and competitive analysis for internal stakeholders.

· Collaborate with regional teams, product management and global marketing to identify market opportunities, collect customer feedback and translate market insights into marketing strategies, go-to-market plans and product positioning.

· Support the development of strategic marketing plans by providing market intelligence, customer insights and competitive analysis that enable data-driven marketing and business decisions.

· Support the planning and execution of international exhibitions, customer events, webinars, product launches and regional marketing activities, coordinating messaging, marketing materials and post-event analysis.

· Develop and maintain business-focused marketing materials, market reports, customer case studies, presentations and sales enablement tools to support regional business development and customer engagement.

· Leverage AI-powered tools and digital technologies to improve market research, business analysis, marketing productivity and cross-functional collaboration.

jobDescription.name: Requirements
jobDescription.value:
· Bachelor's degree or above in Engineering, Energy, Business Administration, Marketing, Communications or a related discipline. Candidates with technical or engineering backgrounds and a strong interest in business marketing are encouraged to apply.

· 5+ years of experience in B2B marketing, business marketing, market intelligence, product marketing or sales enablement, preferably within the renewable energy, energy storage or other industrial technology sectors.

· Experience supporting regional sales teams and collaborating with regional marketing teams in a multinational business environment.

· Experience in the energy storage industry (BESS), particularly utility-scale energy storage, is highly preferred. Experience in the solar PV, power, renewable energy or electrical equipment industries is an advantage.

· Strong understanding of the global energy storage market, including market dynamics, competitive landscape and customer trends.

· Experience supporting global product launches, go-to-market strategies and strategic marketing initiatives.

· Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate market trends, customer insights and competitive intelligence into strategic business recommendations.

· Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.

· Familiarity with AI-powered research, business analysis and marketing productivity tools is highly desirable.

· Fluent in English and Spanish. Additional European languages are considered an advantage.

jobDescription.name: Responsibilities
jobDescription.value:
· Develop high-quality marketing content, including press releases, social media content, website content, presentations, brochures, customer success stories, newsletters and other communication materials to support Trina Storage's global brand and business objectives.

· Support the planning and execution of global marketing campaigns, digital marketing initiatives, product launches, webinars, exhibitions and other marketing activities, while monitoring campaign performance and preparing campaign reports.

· Collaborate with regional marketing teams, product management, sales and external agencies to develop impactful marketing materials and ensure consistent messaging across global markets.

· Manage and maintain marketing content across digital channels, including the corporate website, LinkedIn and newsletters, while supporting the continuous development of Trina Storage's global marketing content library.

· Support executive communications, strategic marketing projects and other initiatives assigned by the Global Marketing Manager, leveraging AI tools to improve content creation, marketing efficiency and global collaboration.

jobDescription.name: Requirements
jobDescription.value:
Education

· Bachelor's degree or above in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, Business Administration or a related discipline.

Experience

· 3+ years of experience in B2B marketing, content marketing, corporate communications or brand marketing, preferably within the renewable energy, energy storage, electrical equipment or industrial technology sectors.

· Experience working in a multinational or international business environment is an advantage.

Professional Skills

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

· Strong storytelling ability with the capability to translate technical and business information into clear, engaging and customer-focused content.

· Experience in digital marketing, social media management and content planning.

· Familiarity with AI-powered content creation tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot or similar platforms) is highly desirable.

· Strong project management, communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Personal Attributes

· Creative, proactive and detail-oriented.

· Passionate about technology, sustainability and global energy trends.

· Comfortable working in a fast-paced international environment.

· Self-motivated, adaptable and a strong team player.

Languages

· Fluent English is mandatory.

· German is highly preferred.

· Chinese and/or other European languages are considered an advantage.

jobDescription.name: Responsibilities
jobDescription.value:
Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate, plan, and deliver grid connection works for NEM-connected renewable energy projects throughout the full project lifecycle.
  • Assess regulatory compliance requirements and conduct internal grid connection point feasibility studies.
  • Manage grid connection applications end-to-end, ensuring timely submission and smooth progression through NSP and AEMO processes.
  • Provide technical support during project development, including supporting balance-of-plant tendering and ensuring grid-related factors are fully considered.
  • Maintain strong relationships with NSPs and OEMs to drive service performance and alignment with company standards.
  • Monitor grid intelligence, implement new connection methods driven by policy updates and industry standards, and develop standardized grid connection arrangements to improve efficiency, reduce timelines and costs, while maintaining or enhancing plant performance.
  • Support project managers with grid expertise across the full project lifecycle, including on-site support as needed.
  • Support asset managers with grid-related expertise during plant operation and maintenance.
  • Identify and unlock value opportunities within transmission and distribution (T&D) networks.
  • Lead grid connection activities for renewable energy and BESS projects, serving as the primary interface with NSPs, AEMO, and external consultants.
  • Independently conduct and review technical due diligence for grid connection matters, including preparation and assessment of GPS-related studies and connection application documentation.
  • Manage external consultants across technical, commercial, and delivery scopes, including schedules, budgets, quality, and technical direction, to achieve practical and efficient connection outcomes.
  • Proactively engage with NSPs and key stakeholders to negotiate technical and commercial positions, resolve connection issues efficiently, and accelerate approval and registration timelines.
  • Maintain strong working relationships and open communication with consultants, NSPs, AEMO, and industry stakeholders to secure timely market intelligence and support successful project delivery.

jobDescription.name: Requirements
jobDescription.value:
Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Thorough understanding of the National Electricity Rules (NER).
  • Working knowledge of the current NEM network status, constraints, upgrade plans, and connection opportunities.
  • Working knowledge of Marginal Loss Factor (MLF) calculation methodology and long-term impact factors.
  • Demonstrated experience engaging with AEMO, NSPs, and grid modelling consultants to progress projects through GPS and connection negotiations.
  • Proven ability to identify and resolve grid connection issues.
  • Working knowledge of substation, BESS, and solar farm reticulation design and construction.
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects.
  • Experience working with EPC contractors and engineering design consultancies.
  • Self-directed and able to manage grid connection processes autonomously.
  • Excellent communication skills; ability to provide grid connection advice and support to multiple project delivery teams.
  • Flexibility to travel across Australian states as required.
  • Eagerness to develop professional capabilities with an established renewable energy developer offering clear career progression.

jobDescription.name: Responsibilities
jobDescription.value:
• Develop and implement the UK & Europe EHS strategy, policies, management systems, and governance framework in line with applicable legislation, industry standards, and company objectives. 
  • Provide strategic EHS leadership and advice to senior management, supporting business decisions, operational planning, and risk management. 
  • Coordinate EHS activities during project execution and service 
  • Review customer EHS requirements during tendering and commercial negotiations and ensure appropriate EHS obligations are incorporated into project execution plans. 
  • Establish and maintain effective management systems for identifying, assessing, managing, mitigating  and monitoring EHS risks during project execution. These systems should cover not only activities and employees of Trina but also contractors, cross-border work teams and any other third-party service providers.
  • Develop and maintain a consistent regional emergency response and management system. Lead incident management, investigations and corrective actions.
  • Establish and oversee EHS assurance programs, including audits, inspections, compliance reviews, performance reporting, and management reviews. 
  • Drive a strong safety culture through leadership engagement, training, coaching, communication, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
  • Maintain relationships with regulators, clients, certification bodies, industry organizations, and other external stakeholders on EHS matters. 
  • Lead and coordinate regional EHS resources, including internal personnel, external consultants, and specialist service providers. 
  • Support the implementation of corporate ESG and sustainable development strategies.
  • Provide regular EHS performance reporting and strategic recommendations to executive leadership.

jobDescription.name: Requirements
jobDescription.value:
• Degree or professional qualification in Environment, Health & Safety, Engineering, or a related discipline. 
  • Significant EHS leadership experience within energy storage, renewable energy, construction, utilities, infrastructure, or other high-risk industries. 
  • Strong knowledge of UK and European EHS legislation and management systems (including ISO 45001). 
  • Proven experience developing EHS strategy, governance frameworks, and organizational capability. 
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and lead EHS performance across multiple countries and complex projects. 
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

jobDescription.name: Responsibilities
jobDescription.value:
Field Technical Support & Troubleshooting

  • Act as second-level technical support for the FSE Supervisor and FSE Crew within the assigned zone, engaging when a fault or incident exceeds field-level troubleshooting capability.
  • Diagnose root cause of recurring or complex faults across BESS systems — batteries, PCS/inverters, BMS/EMS, HVAC and balance-of-plant equipment.
  • Escalate to the OEM/equipment manufacturer when a fault exceeds local resolution capacity, and track the case through to closure.
  • Support incident response and root-cause analysis jointly with the FSE Supervisor, defining and tracking corrective actions within contractual response times.

Maintenance Planning & Engineering

  • Develop and maintain the preventive/predictive maintenance plan for assets in the assigned zone, incorporating OEM technical alerts, defect campaigns and field observations fed back by the FSE Supervisor and FSE Crew.
  • Generate corrective action plans when recurring failure patterns or performance degradation are identified, and track their execution to closure.
  • Recommend improvements to O&M procedures and to the site Maintenance Scope based on lessons learned from field execution.
  • Sequence and prioritize inspection and maintenance campaigns across the zone in coordination with the FSE Supervisor, balancing site access, equipment condition and active OEM alerts.

Availability & Performance Management

  • Monitor plant availability, alarms and degradation indicators across the zone through SCADA/EMS and service management tools, issuing early warnings when trends threaten contractual performance targets.
  • Prioritize technical interventions according to their impact on availability and contractual criticality (LTSA/SLA commitments).
  • Support the FSE Supervisor in evaluating spare-parts and resourcing constraints that could affect maintenance timelines or contractual response commitments.

Reporting & Technical Interface

  • Act as the technical point of contact for client site representatives on engineering matters that exceed the FSE Supervisor's scope of detail.
  • Document and transfer technical knowledge to the FSE Crew to raise first-line troubleshooting capability.
  • Feed maintenance plan status, root-cause findings and recurring-failure trends into the Engineering Lead's zone-level and portfolio engineering reporting.
  • Flag to the Engineering Lead when the assigned zone's site count or technical workload approaches the threshold defined for single-Engineer coverage, to trigger timely evaluation of additional Service Engineer coverage as the portfolio grows.

jobDescription.name: Requirements
jobDescription.value:
Requirements

  • Technical degree or Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronic, Electromechanical Engineering or a related discipline.
  • A minimum of 3–5 years of experience in maintenance or engineering of BESS, solar PV, or other grid-connected/industrial energy assets.
  • Prior experience providing technical support to field crews or subcontracted maintenance teams is preferred.
  • Availability to travel to site as required by the assigned zone.
  • Availability for after-hours escalation on critical incidents, consistent with the 24/7 operational nature of the Maintenance scope.
  • Fluency in Spanish and English is required.

Competencies

  • Working knowledge of BESS/PCS and MV equipment, and ability to read electrical diagrams and single-line drawings.
  • Knowledge of BMS/EMS systems and associated communication protocols (Modbus, DNP3, as applicable).
  • Root cause analysis (RCA) skills and familiarity with maintenance methodologies (RCM, TPM a plus).
  • Working knowledge of SCADA/EMS and remote asset monitoring platforms.
  • Ability to work under reactive pressure without losing planning discipline.
  • Strong technical communication skills with field teams, OEMs and client site representatives.
  • Autonomy — the role operates without constant direct supervision and must prioritize without escalating every decision.

jobDescription.name: Responsibilities
jobDescription.value:
About the Role
Integrated in bidding department and reporting to regional presales coordinator, the engineer will be in charge of the analysis, design and cost estimation of trackers for PV projects. The Engineer is responsible for all aspects of pre-sales engineering of projects in bidding stage. The Pre-Sales Engineer collaborates with Sales team giving technical support to sales and clients.

  • Design and calculation of solar trackers and fixed steel structures for PV plants.
  • Slope analysis and earthworks estimation.
  • Project cost estimation.
  • PVsyst simulation.
  • Technical meetings with clients.
  • KoM alignment.

The Quality & Process Specialist LAC will be responsible for supporting project quality activities across Latin America & Caribbean, ensuring structured problem resolution, effective root cause analysis, document control, process standardization, and knowledge retention.

jobDescription.value:
1. Commercialization and Financing Solutions
  • Lead the commercial negotiations and support the structuring of Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs)/virtual tolling/revenue swaps or other forms of offtake agreements for solar, BESS, hybrid and wind assets.
  • Lead the participation of federal or state level competitive tender process, including CIS, LTESA, RCM tender etc
  • Structure the project financing or any other preferred financing solutions for the assets within portfolio, and manage the competitive financing processes from RfP stage to Financial Close.
  • Collaborate closely with different internal workstreams including business development, legal, finance, and technical to ensure bankable solutions.


b. Project Sales/Divestment

1. Investors outreach and market research

- Identify, target, and nurture potential investors (e.g., yieldco, infrastructure funds, pension funds, IPP, banks, family offices) for renewable asset divestment opportunities in Australia.

- Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with current and prospective investors; conduct regular touchpoints, updates, and executive-level engagements.

- Develop tailored value propositions and investment theses for each investor segment, aligning asset characteristics with investors’ profile and investment preferences.

- Lead credible due diligence pre-engagement (e.g., market reviews, project viability, regulatory considerations) to secure investor interest.

- Coordinate investor communications, meetings, roadshows, and presentations

- Conduct in-depth market research of the precedent transactions for renewable assets in Australia.


2. Deal Preparation

- Lead the preparation of teasers, investment memoranda, process letters and market sounding and marketing activities with selected investors as well as shortlisting of preferred investors

- Conduct market and risk analyses (policy/regulatory landscape, precedent transactions etc, market trend development).

- Coordinate with different internal workstreams to develop due diligence packages for selected investors.



3. Deal Execution

- Lead the negotiation of term sheets, and key commercial terms of the transaction documents (HOT, SPA, JVA, SHA and JDA etc).

- Coordinate and manage cross-functional teams (finance, legal, technical, business development) to advance deals through approval gates.

- Oversee due diligence coordination, including financial modeling refinements, off-take arrangements, financing, and regulatory risk assessment.

- Manage project timelines, milestones, and dependencies; identify and mitigate bottlenecks to maintain targeted closing dates.

- Ensure all deal documentation is accurate, consistent, and aligned with investor expectations and corporate policies.



4) Deal Closing

- Lead the finalization and execution of transaction agreements and related regulatory approval and filings.

- Manage closing logistics with all parties (investors, lenders, developers, EPC/O&M contractors), ensuring readiness for disbursement and start of project financing.

- Obtain internal approvals (executive, risk, legal, compliance) and secure external approvals as required (regulatory bodies, credit committees).

- Ensure all closing conditions are satisfied, risks are documented, and post-closing integration plans are established.

- Maintain rigorous governance, risk management, and record-keeping for each deal.


c) Other Brownfield acquisition opportunities and Joint Development activities

- Support Business Development team on the brownfield acquisition opportunities

- Lead the negotiation of term sheets, and key commercial terms of the related agreements including but not limited to SPA, JVA, SHA, JDA, DSA.

Trina Storage is looking for a LAC–HQ Coordination & Operations Specialist to support our regional Fulfilment & Service organization across Latin America and the Caribbean.
This role will help strengthen coordination between our LAC teams and HQ, ensuring that requests are clearly understood, actions have clear owners and deadlines, and key topics are actively followed up through to resolution.
You will work closely with regional managers and HQ teams across Fulfilment, Service, Engineering, Commissioning, Product and other support functions.
We are looking for a highly organized, proactive and persistent professional who is comfortable working across cultures, languages and time zones, and who can turn complex or pending topics into clear actions and follow-up.

  • Proactively follow up on open issues, pending decisions, approvals, escalations and blocked actions, ensuring clear ownership, deadlines and next steps.
  • Drive actions through to closure and escalate delays or blockers when required.
  • Translate business and operational needs between LAC and HQ, ensuring requests are clearly understood and actionable.
  • Identify missing information, unclear responsibilities, delayed responses and process bottlenecks before they impact project execution.
  • Consolidate inputs from different LAC teams into clear action trackers, status reports and management updates.
  • Maintain visibility of key commitments, milestones, pending actions and escalation items across the regional organization.
  • Build strong working relationships with HQ stakeholders and become a reliable point of contact for LAC-related matters.
